query_feedback: Repair the date-consistency logic so validity, survey, and endorsement dates are compared only with the correspondingly typed SOLAS schedule date records; the current pooled comparison permits a date of one category to satisfy another category and incorrectly requires every linked schedule to contain every Polar date. Locate and use the canonical controlled values for certificateScheduleDateType. Remove sh:minCount 1 constraints that merely turn the universal date-harmonization rule into an unsupported date-existence requirement unless independent requirement evidence establishes mandatory existence.

feedback_appendix: Use this exact term because the validator feedback requires correspondingly typed SOLAS certificate schedule date records, and this canonical string-valued property identifies each schedule date record's category for category-specific date comparisons.
